steps.name: same client follows a deliberate bridge stop/start without stale credentials
an abruptly terminated owned stdio server can be replaced without changing the saved scene
real compound mutation outlives its timed-out client; expired queued write is absent and no nodes are duplicated

method: Real 400-node compound mutation through the unmodified adapter, timeout during progress, expiring queued create, and readback barrier. No API overrides or extension reloads.
note: The larger observer budget permits slow native completion; it does not retry or extend the timed-out write client or the expired queued request.
